annotations.title: Where do US imports of this product come from now?

description: Use when the user asks whether supply of a product has really diversified, how exposed US imports are to one country, or who gained share after tariffs or reshoring. Returns, for two years, the top-three partners' share of US imports of the HS code, the largest single source, a concentration index, and the partners that gained and lost the most share, from UN Comtrade. Refuses before you are charged if the partner rows do not add up to the world total. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Currently switched off: it answers "not available" and charges nothing.

end.description: The later year (the latest full year is usually the one before last).

hs.description: A 4- or 6-digit HS code, e.g. "8542" for integrated circuits.
